author: bI5O
content: Result: deep tone pass complete across all 7 source trees (thermite-verified/-spec/-syntax/-tv, lean/, thermite-lower, forge). 8 commits (7 per-crate + 1 residual-cleanup). All changes comments-only, proven via a code-skeleton byte-identical check on every changed file (strips comments, compares code to HEAD). Followup: caught that the forge editor agent's process was lost mid-run leaving test files half-toned, plus a residual virtue-adverb/emphatic-caps tail across crates; finished it manually and re-verified (virtue adverbs now 0; remaining ALL-CAPS are only verbatim quoted-authority, tool output, status labels, and REQ-status tables). Also reverted one bad edit that landed inside a format!() raw-string (emitted probe source), caught by the byte-identical check. Gauntlet: cargo fmt --check clean; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean (exit 0); lake build green (369 jobs); cargo test green except 5 forge acceptance_programs tests that FAIL IDENTICALLY on the pristine pre-PR baseline (a cc/Undefined-symbols:main linker quirk on this macOS-aarch64 toolchain, independent of comments). Push is blocked by policy -> handing off to user for push + PR + CI.
